## [2026-09-29 — Landscape baseline](../../../landscape/2026-09-29.md) — PARTIAL SEARCH

### [DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.12948>)

DeepSeek-R1 demonstrates large-scale reasoning training with group-relative policy optimization and verifiable rewards, while separating a pure-RL experiment from a staged recipe that improves response usability. It supplies a foundational reference for eliciting reasoning from a strong pretrained model and transferring those capabilities to smaller models through distillation.

**Published:** 2025-01-22 · **First seen:** 2026-09-30T04:09:33Z · **Novelty:** baseline · **Tags:** RLVR, GRPO, Reasoning

**Positioning:** established-method

[Paper](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.12948>) · [Project](<https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1>)

**Evidence:** research-paper; full-text. The January 4, 2026 revision describes rewards, training stages, reasoning evaluations, and failure modes; the published model family enables follow-up study but the original training run was not reproduced here.

**Limitations:** Reliable verifiers are central, model-based rewards can be exploited, and the reported model has overthinking, language-mixing, structured-output, and tool-use limitations; this is a foundational recipe rather than a current leaderboard claim.
